title: Leave room for the mountains
description: An adaptable plan is part of the experience.

copy.original: An adaptable plan is part of the experience.
copy.value: An adaptable plan is part of the experience.

copy.original: Roads, weather, permissions, and local restrictions can change the plan. Discuss alternatives and leave contingency time around onward travel.
copy.value: Roads, weather, permissions, and local restrictions can change the plan. Discuss alternatives and leave contingency time around onward travel.

copy.original: More places can mean more driving and hotel changes. Ask whether fewer bases, extra rest days, or a private route suit your group better.
copy.value: More places can mean more driving and hotel changes. Ask whether fewer bases, extra rest days, or a private route suit your group better.

copy.original: Request a date-specific packing list. Discuss accessibility and dietary arrangements directly. Seek professional advice about altitude or exertion where relevant; a sample itinerary cannot assess individual suitability.
